A rollback

observations.why: Quinton asserts positional authority to set a recurring mandate, then presses compliance by framing unrehearsed rollbacks as effectively nonexistent.
Xena records the cadence as an established fact, controlling the informational basis on which the team operates.
Assigning an owner invokes positional authority to designate accountability, a legitimate-power move.
